mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 59 degrees and overcast near the Reddan Soccer Park with a full moon overhead.

The Planning Department wants to remind you to watch out for scams requesting online wire transfers for permits, as they only accept checks at the administration building. Also, remember that Fall Leaf collection kicks off on October 5th.

We have a busy schedule with live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee happening today, followed by the Verona Fall Fest today as well. Looking ahead, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market tomorrow.
In a report regarding notable calls, on September 5th, police were called to investigate a viral social media prank where vehicles were found with cheese slices on their windshields.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a remodel, but they will open today at 10:00 AM so you can grab their flavor of the day.
